recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If implementers still need primitive-extension-only effectiveDateTime values to pass vsp-1, that should be handled as a new or reopened OO tracker because current source reflects later explicit no-change decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-17717 was a Published/Persuasive OO STU3 issue asking that the Vital Signs vs-1 invariant apply only when Observation.effective[x] is dateTime with a value, that the XPath be corrected, and that Period/nullFlavor-style primitive-extension cases not be rejected by an overbroad rule.

additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml is current build-scope source. Later history removed XPath usage, renamed vs-* constraints to vsp-*, fixed the vsp-1 expression context, removed Period from effective[x] in FHIR-21297, and clarified the human text in FHIR-26964. Later related Jira issues FHIR-29654 and FHIR-34463 re-raised the invariant concern, including hasValue discussion, but OO resolved them Not Persuasive/No Change after concluding the current dateTime-only vsp-1 rule works.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already conveys the approved human rule, no XPath remains to fix, and changing the expression now would reopen later final no-change decisions rather than simply completing FHIR-17717.
